Aero 1.3.1: a chat that looked frozen with many imported skills now answers in seconds.

## Install or update

Aero 1.0 to 1.3 offer this update at startup (**Update now**). New installs:

| System | File | Then |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Windows** 10 / 11 (64-bit) | `Aero-windows.zip` | Extract it, double-click `Update-Aero.bat`, accept the admin prompt. `--dest D:\Aero` installs elsewhere; `--lean` skips setting up the integrations now (Aero finishes them in the background). |
| **macOS** (Apple Silicon or Intel) | `Aero-macos.zip` | Unzip it, right-click `Install-Aero.command` → Open. |
| **Linux**, any distro | `install.sh` | `curl -fsSL https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/releases/latest/download/install.sh \| sh` |
| Debian, Ubuntu, Mint, Pop!_OS | `aero_1.3.1_all.deb` | `sudo apt install ./aero_1.3.1_all.deb` |
| Fedora, RHEL, Rocky, Alma, openSUSE | `aero-1.3.1-1.noarch.rpm` | `sudo dnf install ./aero-1.3.1-1.noarch.rpm` |
| Arch, Manjaro, EndeavourOS | `PKGBUILD` | `makepkg -si` |
| Any Linux, by hand | `Aero-linux.tar.gz` | `sh Aero/install.sh` |

Models, chats, memory, settings, keys, tunings, skills and mods carry over.

## Fixed

- **Hundreds of imported skills overflowed the router** (400 Bad Request): only the 12 that match the message go to
  it now, and a failed router offers the usual few tools instead of all of them.
- **One model slot when the graphics card is nearly full**, so the prompt isn't read from shared memory (~200
  instead of ~1,260 tokens/s).
- **Long prompts show progress**: "Reading N tokens: X% (about S s left)".
- **"Open my Chrome" uses Aero's own browser** instead of launching yours again and again.
- **Runaway tool calls**: an app starts once per request, the same call runs at most 3 times per request, the step
  limit ends with an answer, guessing at addresses keeps at most 3 tabs open, and compaction in the middle of a
  request keeps the request.
- **Thinking that goes in circles is stopped** (one case repeated a paragraph for 3 minutes and answered nothing);
  the model answers without it.
- **No re-reading an unchanged file** more than 3 times per request, and a skill's own files are found from the
  paths in its instructions.
- **Skills match word forms**: "documents" finds "documentation", "diagram" finds `diagram-design`.

The request that froze now takes about 15 seconds. Full list: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/blob/main/source/CHANGELOG.md).
